maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is fee-based gathering, compression, processing and transportation of producers' volumes, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil and gas producers in the Delaware Basin paying midstream fees; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic pipeline and plant buildout and volume growth with producers; acquisitions are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Producers depend on its dedicated pipelines, processing plants and water systems to reach market; switching is costly and often contractually dedicated.
